purpose: Independent practice of E2.3 — calendar reading.
student_learning_goal: I can read the date and find days, weeks, months on a calendar.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can read the date and find days, weeks, months on a calendar.
header.character_watermark: Cal the Calendar Cat in the top-right corner with a small calendar. Small (~1.5in tall). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.student_instructions: Look at the calendar. Mark TODAY with a star. Mark next FRIDAY with a heart.
parts.visual_layout: A monthly calendar grid (5 weeks × 7 days = 35 cells) with month name at top and day-of-week labels.

image_placeholders.description: A monthly calendar grid for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Month label at top (use current month). Day-of-week header: Sun Mon Tue Wed Thu Fri Sat. 5 rows of 7 cells each, with date numbers 1-30 (or appropriate). Each cell ~1in × 1in. Generous space for marking with star or heart.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P1_CALENDAR at Part 1: instructions ask the child to mark today and Friday. Keywords name the visual element and target dates.

parts.answer_key: Mark on today's date and the next Friday on the calendar.

parts.student_instructions: Count days in the month. Write the number.
parts.visual_layout: Below the calendar from Part 1, a question line.

image_placeholders.description: A question line for a Grade 1 worksheet. 'There are ___ days in this month.' Below: 'There are ___ weeks in this month.'
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P2_COUNT at Part 2: instructions ask the child to count days. Keywords name the units.

parts.student_instructions: Name 2 Canadian holidays. Tell which season each is in.

image_placeholders.description: Two response rows for a Grade 1 worksheet, B&W line art. Each row: 'Holiday: ___ Season: ___' with two writing lines.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS04_P3_HOLIDAYS at Part 3: instructions ask the child to name holidays and seasons. Keywords name the prompt focus.

parts.answer_key: Any 2 valid Canadian holidays + seasons. Sample: 'Canada Day — summer'. 'Family Day — winter'. 'Thanksgiving — fall'.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, find what day of the week it is in 7 days.
teacher_notes: Lesson 4 consolidation artifact. Use Part 1 as the formative signal — children who can navigate forward to next Friday have grasped calendar use.
